description: The line plot illustrates the similarity of hidden states (HSAs) across different language pairs within the Qwen1.5-1.8B model, with the horizontal axis representing the layer number from 0 to 24 and the vertical axis showing similarity values ranging from 0.00 to 0.45. Four language pairs are depicted: 'en&en' (red), 'en&es' (blue), 'en&el' (green), and 'en&bn' (pink). The red line ('en&en') starts at approximately 0.07 at layer 0, rises to a peak of 0.26 at layer 6, then declines steadily to 0.08 at layer 20 before sharply increasing to 0.43 at layer 23. The blue line ('en&es') begins at 0.06, peaks at 0.24 at layer 6, and remains relatively stable, leveling off around 0.06 from layer 20 onward without a significant rise. The green line ('en&el') and pink line ('en&bn') follow similar trajectories, starting at 0.04 and 0.03 respectively, peaking at layer 6 with values of 0.15 and 0.13, declining to 0.05 at layer 20, and then rising to 0.3 at layer 23. Notably, the similarity between 'en&es' exceeds that of 'en&en' from layer 6 to 20, which is contrary to expectations.
